# A comment above parentheses that are kept moves inside them.
celfmt -i src.cel -o out1.cel
! stderr .
cmp out1.cel want.txt

# Verify idempotency.
celfmt -i out1.cel -o out2.cel
! stderr .
cmp out1.cel out2.cel

-- src.cel --
// New request
(
	state.a + state.b
) * 4
-- want.txt --
(
	// New request
	state.a + state.b
) * 4
